description: What a global setup's globalThis is (T9.15): the setup sets a global, the teardown (the same process) sees it, and a test file run by a worker does not. Each writes a line to seen.txt, which the black-box run captures. Two test files and two workers, so Jest runs them in worker processes: in band (one worker or one file) the test environment copies the main process's globals, the setup's included, into its context, and the test sees it.
